interface.name: aetheri_development_desktop_v1
interface.description: Available only on the independently inherited desktop connection. This is development window management, not app/run admission, security UI or an SDK. Window IDs are session-local, never reused and are not process identities. Metadata is descriptive, never publisher/installation/permission evidence.

request.name: retire
request.description: The server acknowledges this on the original connection. Departure then ends this development compositor. No lease or normal app state is settled.
